# NextGrade

> Free Indian festival wishes, festival dates, children's stories, desi games and small tools, in Hindi, English, Hinglish and Bengali. No sign-up, works on any phone. Every page exists in 4 languages: Hindi at https://nextgrade.in/, English at https://nextgrade.in/en/, Hinglish at https://nextgrade.in/hinglish/, Bengali at https://nextgrade.in/bn/.

All text is written by NextGrade or is public domain (old folk tales retold in our own words).

## Free online calculators (run in the browser)

- [All calculators](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/)
- [Age Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/age/): Enter your date of birth to find how many years, months and days old you are — and how many days are left until your next birthday.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/percentage/): Quickly find a percentage of any number — for example, "10% of 500 = 50".
- [EMI Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/emi/): Enter the loan amount, interest rate and tenure to find your monthly instalment (EMI), total interest and total payment.
- [BMI Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/bmi/): Enter your weight and height to find your Body Mass Index (BMI) and whether it is in the healthy range.
- [SIP Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/sip/): Enter how much you invest each month, for how many years and the expected return, and see how much your money can grow.
- [GST Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/gst/): Enter an amount and the GST rate — whether you want to add GST or find the base price from a GST-inclusive amount.
- [Discount Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/discount/): Enter the original price and the discount percentage to instantly see how much you save and the new price.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/date-difference/): Choose two dates and find the difference between them in days, weeks, months and years.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/simple-interest/): Enter the principal, interest rate and time to find the simple interest and the total amount.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/compound-interest/): Enter the principal, rate, time and how often interest is added, to find the compound interest and total amount.
- [FD (Fixed Deposit) Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/fd/): Enter the deposit, interest rate and time to find how much interest your FD earns and the total at maturity.
- [Mileage Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/mileage/): Enter the distance you travelled and the fuel used to find your mileage — and the trip cost too, if you add the fuel price.
- [Marks Percentage Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/marks-percentage/): Enter your marks obtained and the total marks to instantly find your percentage and grade.
- [RD (Recurring Deposit) Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/rd/): Enter how much you deposit each month, for how many months and the interest rate, to find the total at maturity.
- [Loan Eligibility Calculator](https://nextgrade.in/en/calculator/loan-eligibility/): Enter the EMI you can comfortably pay each month, the interest rate and tenure, to find how much loan that EMI can get you.

## Tools

- [Passport Size Photo Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/passport-photo/): White or blue background, face centred automatically, 3.5×4.5 cm / 2×2 inch, a 4×6 print sheet and a digital photo under any KB limit.
- [Document Scanner → PDF](https://nextgrade.in/tools/doc-scanner/): Scan documents with your phone: auto crop, black & white, many pages in one PDF, and under 100/200 KB.
- [Image Compressor — 20/50/100 KB](https://nextgrade.in/tools/image-compress/): Make a photo 20, 50, 100, 200 KB or any size. JPG or WebP, many photos at once, ZIP download.
- [PDF Compressor — 100/200/500 KB](https://nextgrade.in/tools/pdf-compress/): Make a PDF smaller than 100, 200, 500 KB or 1 MB for form uploads. Black & white option for scans.
- [JPG / Photo to PDF](https://nextgrade.in/tools/jpg-to-pdf/): Many photos (marksheet, ID, certificates) into one PDF — A4, reorder, rotate, and a KB limit.
- [PDF Merge & Split](https://nextgrade.in/tools/pdf-merge/): Join PDFs into one, take out or delete pages, rotate pages — text and quality stay the same.
- [Image Resizer — px / cm / inch](https://nextgrade.in/tools/image-resize/): Resize a photo to an exact size: 3.5×4.5 cm, 200×230, 600×600 or your own — with crop, background and a KB limit.
- [Image Crop & Rotate](https://nextgrade.in/tools/image-crop/): Crop a photo (1:1, 4:3, 16:9, passport), rotate, straighten and flip — save as JPG, PNG or WebP.
- [Signature Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/signature-maker/): Sign on the screen or clean up a photo of a signature on paper — transparent PNG or white JPG, at form size and KB.
- [Hindi & English Typing Test](https://nextgrade.in/tools/typing-test/): 1 to 15 minute typing test: WPM, accuracy and wrong words. Practise for SSC-style tests, backspace on/off.
- [Land Unit Converter — Bigha, Katha, Acre](https://nextgrade.in/tools/land-converter/): Bigha, katha, biswa, kanal, acre, hectare, gaj and sq ft — by state.
- [QR Code Maker — UPI, Link, WhatsApp](https://nextgrade.in/tools/qr-maker/): UPI payment QR (with amount), link, text, phone, WhatsApp and Wi-Fi QR codes — download PNG or SVG.
- [Sticker Maker](https://nextgrade.in/tools/sticker-maker/): Turn a photo into a sticker: background removed, white outline, top/bottom text — 512×512 WebP. Text stickers too.
- [Exam Form Photo & Signature Resizer](https://nextgrade.in/tools/form-helper/): Photo, signature, thumb and declaration at the exact px and KB that SSC, UPSC, IBPS / SBI, NEET and JEE forms ask for. Cleans up a signature on paper.
